<!-- pr-reviewer: 77f402386fdb50bef1b3527ecfa177799efd8bd1 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge - the PR no longer merges with `main` (conflicts); the code itself is clean.**

**What looks good**
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `recognize/` or `mcp/pockets.rs`; every index goes through `.get()` (e.g. `walls.rs:99,106,141,167,207`), casts are guarded (`mcp/pockets.rs:63`), and `operation_for` refuses a non-finite or zero depth or width by name (`recognize/op.rs:36,50`). `degenerate_input_refuses_cleanly` covers an unknown model, NaN/inf/zero-area facets and a torn mesh.
- Gouge question: a Slot is only chosen when no closed end is square (`op.rs:17`), so a round cap never stands in for a sharp corner; open ends run out past the floor edge into stock or air, not into the part; an open pocket is a Pocket on the floor face, so the part's own rings bound the cut. Tests check the path stays inside the ring and generates with no Gouge.
- Provenance lines present, new files all under 400 lines, decision record in `docs/decisions/`, no CHANGELOG edit, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #35`, no deps/build.rs/scripts/.github touched.

**Local results (PR head, debug; NOT merged with main because of the conflicts)**

| suite | result |
|---|---|
| pocket_recognition | 10 passed |
| mcp_pockets | 3 passed |
| mcp | 13 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge conflicts with `main` in three registration lists, all "keep both sides":
   - `crates/app/src/lib.rs` (`pub mod recognize;` vs `pub mod raster;`),
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs` (`mod pockets;` vs `mod render;`),
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:9` (`use super::{..., pockets}` vs `render`; the tool table likely needs both too).
   Please `git merge origin/main`, re-run the quick gate, push. The PR is turned back into a draft meanwhile.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- As the PR says, a recognised Slot cannot post until #510 is fixed (round-cap gouge false positive); that is a refusal, not a silent wrong path, so it is safe.
- A Slot is authored from the stock source (judgement call 3); if the cutter is wider than the slot, please confirm the Slot op refuses it by name (not exercised in this review).
- This is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7e39726ed820b8e71e3d37abc2c05ad3fb7f66e7 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** - one Prime Directive blocker (an inside-out mesh yields a wrong-side "pocket"); everything else is clean.

**What looks good**
- Merges cleanly with current main (the earlier keep-both registration conflicts are resolved).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `recognize/` or `mcp/pockets.rs`; indexing goes through `.get()`; the wall flood is bounded by a `seen` vector and a footprint window (`walls.rs` `wall_top`).
- Floor Z and walls come from the facets' own geometry; a pocket requires the walls to rise from the floor and lean into it, so a boss, shoulder, corner step and top face are rejected (tests cover them). Open and through slots, open pockets and corner radii are reported by name; a square closed end is a Pocket rather than a Slot (`op.rs:17`). Through pockets without a floor face are listed as not recognised.
- Creation goes through `CreateOperation`, one undo step (tested, including MCP undo/redo). Provenance lines present, every file under 400 lines, decision record present, no CHANGELOG/deps/build.rs/.github changes.

**Local results (merged with origin/main, debug)**

| check | result |
|---|---|
| pocket_recognition | 10 passed |
| mcp_pockets | 3 passed |
| mcp | 13 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Refuse an inside-out or non-closed mesh by name. `pockets_of` (`recognize/mod.rs:99-137`) reads "up" and "leans into" straight from facet winding and never asks the body-winding verdict that #387 added (`pick/winding.rs`, `verdict_for` / `refusal`, used in `pick/align.rs:157`). I checked with a throwaway test (not committed): a plain 10 mm cube with every facet reversed returns `Ok([Pocket { kind: Closed, floor_z: 0.0, .. }])` - its bottom face now "faces up" and its outer walls "lean in", so the part's own outline is reported as a closed pocket as deep as the part. A reversed pocketed block is reported the same way. `detect_pockets create` would then post a Pocket whose region is the part's footprint, cut down to the base. Please run the winding verdict first (as the pick tools do), return its refusal text from `pockets_of`, and add a pinning test with a reversed cube and a reversed pocket block that expects the named refusal. A torn/open mesh should take the same route (the existing torn-half test only checks no panic).

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Draft/tapered walls: a wall counts at any lean above 0.05 (`walls.rs` `WALL_LEAN`), so a tapered pocket is recognised with floor outline as its boundary and top Z at the highest wall point; the Pocket then uses the floor ring. That is safe (never wider than the floor) but the draft is not reported; worth a line in the decision record.
- Corner radius smaller than the tool is reported (`min_corner_radius`) but not checked at creation; that is left to the generator as for a typed Pocket.
- A recognised Slot cannot post until #510; a too-wide cutter is refused at generation, as the author notes.
- This is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

@mkinney: this PR is flagged ready, so please turn it back to draft yourself if you want to push the fix; I have left its state as you set it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7e39726ed820b8e71e3d37abc2c05ad3fb7f66e7 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The merge with main is clean: all three registration lists keep both sides (`recognize` + `raster` in lib.rs, `pockets` + `render` in mcp/mod.rs and the tools.rs import), and a fresh trial merge with current upstream/main applies with no conflicts.
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `recognize/` or `mcp/pockets.rs`; lookups go through `.get()`; `operation_for` refuses non-finite or zero depth/width by name; `degenerate_input_refuses_cleanly` covers unknown model, NaN/inf/zero-area facets and a torn mesh.
- Undo: creation is one `CreateOperation` step (tests check undo removes it). Layering ui -> app respected (app + MCP only), no new components.
- Provenance lines on every new module, all files under 400 lines, decision record in `docs/decisions/`, no CHANGELOG edit, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #35`, no deps/build.rs/scripts/.github touched.

**Local results (PR head merged with upstream/main, debug)**

| suite | result |
|---|---|
| pocket_recognition | 10 passed |
| mcp_pockets | 3 passed |
| mcp | 13 passed |
| mcp_render | 5 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- A recognised Slot cannot post until #510 (round-cap gouge false positive) is fixed; that is a refusal, not a silent wrong path. Likewise a slot narrower than the cutter is created but refuses at generation (`slots.rs:144`), never posts.
- Thresholds (cosine -0.9, 2 widths, 3% area, 60 degrees) are tuning calls, as the author flagged; the GUI entry point is follow-up #511.
- Snapshot/golden files untouched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
